job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE

WHO IS TALUTION GROUP?
Talution Group is a technology recruiting and staffing firm that provides  direct-hire and project based talent solutions to companies that need to attract, hire, and retain talented people. We pride ourselves on the ability to engage passive talent in a competitive tech space and play an instrumental role in advancing their careers. While we serve an international client base, our mission for Talution is to be the Talent solution for our clients. 

THE OPPORTUNITY:
We're adding a team member to join our growing troop of experts. You will report to and work alongside the team’s Vice President of Sales. Through hands-on training with  our VP and experienced team members, you will learn how to qualify and place highly sought-after professionals in the technology industry. You will become a subject matter expert on the most desired tech roles and deliver top-notch talent to our clients.  

Are you passionate about working with a wide variety of clients ranging from boutique technology firms to global financial service firms?
Are you interested in supporting fast-paced SMB clients that push cutting edge technology forward?
Do you have a willingness to understand our clients’ needs and reflect their values by creating a positive interview process? Do you have a desire to manage and grow accounts?

The Talution Group team is very diligent when qualifying prospective candidates by fully understanding our client’s needs and ensuring Infratech Consultants are supported during each phase of the process from the interview to wrapping up a client engagement. We build meaningful and lasting relationships with our clients and consultants.

OUR EXPECTATIONS:
Work alongside your manager in order to gain a firm understanding of the full life cycle recruitment process
Identify, source, and reach out to candidates that meet client requirements by leveraging provided resources
Qualify candidate competencies in reference to the position description and insights provided from the client
Ensure prospective candidate-culture fit and core values by asking behavioral-based screening questions
Research our clients to understand the competitive landscape and pitch them to candidates
Actively participate during training sessions and tutorials given by our team’s various subject matter experts
Collaborate with client account managers in order to learn the intangible qualities a hiring manager desires
Collaborate with the sourcing and research team to learn best practices for identifying a challenging
Nurture relationships with placed consultants as well as manage expectations and performance
Uncover business leads by gathering market intel via candidate activity and other available sources

YOUR CREDS:
1+  years of recruiting or applicable sales experience
Demonstrated success in a customer-centric environment
High sense of urgency and self-confidence while working in a results-oriented environment
Exceptional time management and organizational skills with the ability to work independently and on a team
Competitive, self-motivated work ethic

YOUR GROWTH at TALUTION GROUP:
Within 1 month you’ll:
Be fully on-boarded to our various systems and tools.
Sit-in with experienced team members to learn the ropes of our business.
Watch relevant training videos that cover various technologies, systems and recruitment strategies.
Within 3 months you’ll:
Have learned how to track your activity through Bullhorn and manage your metrics in Bullhorn Analytics.
Contribute to the recruiting team’s goals utilizing different tools and strategies you learned.
Have the knowledge, skills, and abilities to recruit on your own using best practices.
Within 6 months you’ll:
Have the knowledge and training to understand market trends in the tech space and use this to target top talent and maintain a ‘bench’ of opportunistic candidates.
Be strategically exposed and have the confidence to run a ‘full-desk.’
Build a network presence through our partnerships and sponsored events, helping to grow your influence over our target market.

OUR PERKS:
Competitive base salary + commission!
Complete tech recruitment training and a “Do What’s Right” mentality!
We provide opportunities to expand your depth of knowledge and scope of responsibility!
We foster an environment of flexibility and work-life balance!
Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, PTO, onsite gym and more!
Our rockstar employees have significant tenure the staffing industry!
We have an established client base with more jobs than we can fill with the current team!
Casual work environment - no suits required!
Leadership’s commitment to personal and professional growth is a top priority!

We strongly encourage people of color, LGBTQ+ community, veterans and active-duty military, parents, individuals with disabilities, and individuals from all cultural backgrounds to apply. We believe in the power of teams that draw from diverse backgrounds.
 
**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, ethnic origin, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**

job.title: HubSpot Marketing Operations Manager
job.description:
Position Summary

Our client is seeking a hands-on Marketing Operations Manager to own and execute within its HubSpot environment as the organization migrates from Marketo to HubSpot and modernizes its marketing technology stack.

This is not a strategy-only role. The ideal candidate will personally build, deploy, automate, optimize, and scale marketing campaigns while serving as the internal HubSpot expert. This individual will work closely with Product Marketing, Brand, Website, Webinar, and Salesforce teams to build scalable marketing operations and support business growth.

The successful candidate is proactive, execution-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership with minimal direction.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary HubSpot Marketing Hub administrator.
  • Build and deploy marketing emails within HubSpot.
  • Build and maintain marketing automation workflows.
  • Create and manage landing pages, forms, recipient lists, and audience segmentation.
  • Build lifecycle automation and nurture campaigns.
  • QA all campaigns for links, personalization, workflows, rendering, automation, and deliverability.
  • Schedule and deploy campaigns.
  • Monitor campaign performance and reporting.
  • Maintain marketing database integrity.
  • Partner with Salesforce/Revenue Operations on CRM integrations and data flow.
  • Help architect scalable marketing processes as the HubSpot environment continues to mature.
  • Recommend process improvements and platform optimizations.


Required Experience

  • Minimum 3 years of Marketing Operations experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on HubSpot Marketing Hub administration preferred.
  • Experience building and executing campaigns inside HubSpot.
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Marketing automation
  • Workflows
  • Email marketing
  • Segmentation
  • Lifecycle marketing
  • CRM architecture
  • Salesforce integrations
  • Strong QA mindset and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must-Have Qualifications
  • Biggest Screening Criteria


Candidate must have personally owned a HubSpot implementation or major HubSpot project from the ground up.

 

This is a remote, work from home position. This role is to be filled outside the states of California and Colorado.

 

 

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, ethnic origin, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**

job.title: Senior Marketing Analyst
job.description:
Senior Marketing Analyst

We are seeking a highly skilled and technically strong Senior Marketing Analyst with deep expertise in SQL and Power BI to support, measure, and optimize marketing performance across both digital and offline channels. This is a hands-on, data-driven role focused on transforming complex datasets into reliable insights that inform marketing strategy and business decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain advanced SQL queries to transform, aggregate, and analyze large-scale marketing, customer, and revenue datasets.
  • Build and maintain analytical datasets and reporting tables supporting marketing performance, attribution, and experimentation.
  • Develop, manage, and optimize Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, and dashboards used by marketing leaders and executives.
  • Create executive-level dashboards that clearly communicate performance, trends, and key drivers across channels including PPC, SEO, Paid Social, Organic Social, Display, Email, CTV, Linear TV, Print, and OOH.
  • Monitor and validate data quality, investigate anomalies, and ensure consistency across reporting sources and dashboards.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting automation, scalability, efficiency, and performance.
  • Support additional analytical initiatives and responsibilities as needed.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Advanced SQL expertise, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, and query performance optimization.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining Power BI datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and advanced DAX measures.
  • Demonstrated ability to design data models that support flexible slicing, multi-period comparisons, and executive-level reporting.
  • Experience analyzing multi-channel marketing data from platforms such as Google, Bing, Meta, and programmatic or CTV platforms.
  • Strong understanding of marketing KPIs, attribution concepts, and performance measurement frameworks.
  • Ability to translate technical analysis into clear business insights and effectively communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in analytics, statistics, economics, marketing, or a related field.
  • Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Azure Synapse, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with data modeling concepts including star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and fact tables.
  • Experience with attribution modeling, incrementality testing, or causal inference methodologies.
  • Experience optimizing Power BI performance, including query folding, data models, and report performance.
  • Familiarity with Python or R for advanced analytics is a plus.
  • Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and marketing data integrations.
  • Experience working with ServiceTitan or similar operational data platforms is a plus.

job.title: BPM Consultant (.NET / PowerApps)
job.description:
BPM Consultant 
 
Duration: 6 Months Initial
 
Headcount: 2 Consultants
 
Project Summary
 
AITX is seeking two highly technical BPM Project Consultants to bridge the gap between business operational workflows and our technical ecosystem. The primary objective is to map current business processes directly into the Power Apps platform while ensuring seamless integration with our Fleet product environment. We are looking for consultants who function as both process architects and systems integrators, capable of driving automation that aligns with AITX’s specific fleet management requirements.
 
Key Responsibilities

  • Workflow Mapping & Optimization: Analyze and document current business operational workflows. Architect these processes for the Power Apps platform to eliminate bottlenecks and process debt.
  • Technical Implementation (Power Apps / .NET):
  • Design, build, and deploy robust workflow automations using Power Apps and .NET.
  • Develop and manage integration points between Power Apps and the Fleet Product, ensuring data consistency and workflow continuity.
  • System Integration: Serve as the technical lead for bridging disparate platforms, ensuring that business logic executed in Power Apps correctly updates and interacts with Fleet Product data services.
  • Governance & Standardization: Ensure all automated workflows adhere to AITX architectural standards, documentation requirements, and compliance protocols.
  • Metrics & Reporting: Define and track KPIs (e.g., process execution time, integration reliability) to measure the success of the platform migration and integration efforts.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • BPM Expertise: Demonstrated experience in process re-engineering and streamlining workflows within an engineering or product-focused organization.
  • Power Apps Mastery: Deep, hands-on experience building complex, enterprise-grade workflows in Power Apps.
  • Technical Integration Skills: Experience managing the "middle layer" of software environments, with a strong ability to write logic that facilitates communication between business process tools (Power Apps) and core fleet software. 
  • Collaboration: High level of comfort working directly with product and engineering teams to ensure solutions are scalable and maintainable.

Success Metrics

  • Automation Coverage: Successful migration and mapping of core business processes into Power Apps.
  • Integration Stability: Seamless data exchange and functional interoperability between Power Apps and Fleet Product.
  • Efficiency Gains: Measurable reduction in manual intervention through automation cross-platform workflows.
  • Process Clarity: Completion of comprehensive process documentation and training to support the internal team in maintaining the integrated workflows.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • BPM Expertise: Demonstrated experience in process re-engineering, Lean, or Agile transformation within an engineering organization.
  • PowerApps Mastery: Proven ability to build and deploy enterprise-grade PowerApps. Deep understanding of Canvas Apps, Dataverse modeling, and complex Power Apps flows.
  • Technical Proficiency (.NET): Strong hands-on experience with the .NET stack (C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET). Must be comfortable reviewing code, writing integration logic, and communicating with senior engineers at an architectural level.
  • Collaboration: High level of comfort working directly within a software engineering culture (DevOps familiarity is a plus).

 

This is a remote, work from home position. This role is to be filled outside the states of California and Colorado.

 

 

**We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, ethnic origin, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.**

job.title: Market Risk Consultant
job.description:
Market Risk Consultant

Position Overview

A leading financial institution is launching a new Securities Clearing House, which will initially offer clearing services for cash treasuries as well as Bilateral and Tri-party Repo. The Market Risk Consultant will be responsible for the daily monitoring of market risk and managing obligations in the event of a clearing member default.

The consultant will perform in-depth research and analysis of market, credit, and trading data to identify risks, develop mitigation processes, and present findings to senior management. The candidate serves as the first line of defense against systemic, idiosyncratic, and counterparty-specific risks by performing daily assessments of market conditions.

Additionally, this role is responsible for measuring key risks, creating reports for internal governance committees, and escalating issues as appropriate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Liaise with market risk, financial surveillance, and other departments to familiarize stakeholders with counterparty credit, liquidity, and collateral risk profiles.

  • Risk Monitoring & Stress Testing: Perform daily procedures to monitor risk to the clearinghouse, including credit and liquidity stress testing, and escalate findings as necessary.

  • Regulatory Compliance: Demonstrate a strong understanding of applicable domestic and international regulations, as well as a firm grasp of the clearinghouse’s internal rule book.

  • Model Maintenance: Use technical skills—including knowledge of programming and financial mathematics—to maintain risk models.

  • Regulatory Reporting: Assist in preparing responses to ad hoc regulatory requests.

Skills and Software Requirements

  • Market Knowledge: Strong understanding of Fixed Income, Cash Treasuries, and Repo Markets.

  • Technical Proficiency: Experienced in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

  • Financial Tools: Proficiency with Bloomberg terminals.

  • Data Management: Familiarity with relational databases (e.g., MS SQL, Oracle) and SQL, with the ability to manipulate large data sets.

  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical, quantitative, financial analysis (intermediate level), and organizational skills.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present findings clearly to senior management.

  • Work Style: Capability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team setting.

Work Schedule

Note: This position requires a daily presence in our office, 5 days a week.

job.title: Cybersecurity Lead Engineer /Architect
job.description:
The Cybersecurity Lead Engineer/Architect is the firm’s most senior individual contributor in security, joining a lean security operations team responsible for the continued evolution, design, and advancement of the firm’s cybersecurity program. This role deliberately blends high-level strategy and security architecture direction with hands-on implementation engineering: setting the technical vision, reference architectures, and standards while personally building, configuring, and hardening the controls that bring them to life. The role safeguards the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of firm data and systems in alignment with organizational policies and regulatory expectations, leading the design and implementation of security architecture, controls, and technical solutions across the enterprise while proactively identifying risks and recommending strategic improvements.

This individual operates as a highly self-directed contributor within a team responsible for cybersecurity and enterprise risk. The role requires independent assessment of emerging threats, evaluation of control effectiveness, prioritization of initiatives, and ownership of security-focused projects and architectural roadmaps from concept through execution. The Cybersecurity Lead Engineer/Architect regularly collaborates with infrastructure, software engineering, and service desk teams to drive measurable improvements in the firm’s security posture.

As an onsite/hybrid employee, you are expected to be in the office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursday.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect, design, implement, and continuously enhance security controls across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and SDLC, operating hands-on from design through deployment and tuning.
  • Lead security-focused projects, including scoping, planning, execution, stakeholder communication, and documentation.
  • Own and optimize core security tooling (Application security, AI security, endpoint protection, IDS/IPS, SIEM, vulnerability management, cloud security, etc.), ensuring effective configuration and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and implement automation to enhance threat detection, alerting, response workflows, ticket creation, and reporting metrics.
  • Partner with cross-functional technology teams to embed secure design principles and hardening standards into infrastructure, cloud platforms, and application development (DevSecOps).
  • Lead the firm’s AI security program, establishing governance, guardrails, and technical controls that secure the enterprise’s adoption and use of AI
  • Partner with product and software engineering teams to enable secure AI engineering and development, embedding threat modeling, secure-by-design patterns, and safeguards.
  • Monitor compliance with cybersecurity policies and regulatory requirements; identify gaps and drive remediation efforts.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point during incident response and contribute to post-incident analysis and control improvements.
  • Identify emerging threats, tools, and technologies and recommend strategic direction for the cybersecurity program.

 

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity or information security engineering roles, including time in a lead, principal, or security architect capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and engineering security controls in enterprise environments.
  • Experience leading or independently managing technical security projects.
  • Strong familiarity with CIS Framework and system hardening standards.
  • Hands-on experience securing and monitoring cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, etc.).
  • Deep understanding of common security controls including DLP, MFA, encryption, intrusion detection, and mobile device/application management.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills (PowerShell, Python, or similar) with software engineering experience preferred
  • Experience designing and maintaining centralized logging and SIEM solutions.
  • Ability to independently assess risk, define problems, and implement practical, scalable solutions.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and represent the security function effectively.
  • Proven experience designing enterprise security architecture and reference architectures, balancing strategic, roadmap-level direction with hands-on implementation.
  • Experience securing AI/ML systems and enterprise AI adoption, including familiarity with AI-specific risks (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage, model abuse) and frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
  • Experience threat modeling and partnering with software and product engineering teams to enable secure AI and application development.
  • Experience in financial services or investment management preferred.
  • Relevant security certifications (CISSP, CISM, GIAC, AWS Security, etc.) are a plus.
